items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: Yeah, and so I was wondering if you'd listen to Jimmy Harrison, or Sandy Williams, or Louis Armstrong.

ctx.x: No, no, he didn't. He didn't. I recall now. He didn't use it on that.
Yeah, and so I was wondering if you'd listen to Jimmy Harrison, or Sandy Williams, or Louis Armstrong. To me, Armstrong affected a lot of trombone players, yeah.
Yeah. Affected every musician that plays.
